content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Resubmission would not correct the authorization defect, while a formal appeal is permitted and is the only available payer action with any success on similar claims (3 of 15). The documentation quality is strong enough to support a medical-necessity appeal.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
